name: language-tutor
description: Personal language tutor PWA (Mandarin, Italian) on Cloudflare Workers + D1, backed by the Claude API.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate && wrangler deploy
scripts.smoke: bash scripts/smoke.sh && bash scripts/smoke-chat.sh && node scripts/smoke-phase2.mjs

PASSPHRASE.description: Choose the passphrase you will sign in with, **12 or more characters**. Anyone who knows it can use your tutor.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Your Claude API key from [console.anthropic.com](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys) (starts `sk-ant-`). Set a monthly spend limit there too.
